subject: Kickoff: CATE video embeddings for the platform
body:
Hi Bruno, Yusuf,

Kickoff for the CATE video-embedding effort. Our ICCV work on Composable Augmentation Encoding gives us self-supervised video representations with no labeling cost, and the released assets are unusually product-ready: a Kinetics-400-pretrained model with a working inference colab, nearest-neighbor classification demo on UCF-101, and Something-Something v1/v2 checkpoints in the same storage layout for transfer studies.

Product shape: a video-embedding endpoint for data-platforms customers - similarity search and dedup over video libraries without asking anyone to label anything.

Milestones for Apr 20 - Jul 6: M1 (May 15) repro of the UCF-101 nearest-neighbor demo from the released checkpoint, embeddings behind an internal batch API. M2 (Jun 12) cost + quality study for serving - this is where the model-size question bites. M3 (Jun 30) go/no-go on a customer-facing endpoint.

Yusuf is TL. Bruno: staffing plus the serving-cost plan.

Dmitri
